data.body: RP-03 retry-envelope decision approved on 2026-08-17 after parallel Actions-log, OSS-default, and current-behavior validation. Approved values: 3 total calls per atomic logical operation, 15s cumulative inline sleep, 2/4s fallback with nonnegative jitter, provider delay as a lower bound with retry_not_before deferral, and one shared-budget observe/replan cycle. Readiness polling is separate; physical/logical telemetry is required. Durable detail is on rubellite-secondary-cub and in .joe-janitor/rp03-retry-envelope-validation.md. RP-04 remains untouched.
